export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/key-wee-international) shows 43 records, all on the IMPORT side, e.g. exact line: "2026-02-18 | ZHEJIANG FUDAI INDUSTRIAL TRADING CO.,LTD | KEY WEE INTERNATIONAL | STEEL DOORS WITH STANDARD ACCESSORIES | Ningbo, CHINA -> TUGLAKABAD ICD INTKD6, India | 73083000 | BOL 7595845". No export bill-of-lading, no outbound destination and no export HS line appears anywhere on the page. Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 43 Records detected"; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 (2026-02-18, 2026-01-26, 2025-07-31, 2025-06-02, 2025-01-29), all imports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found. Searches for the company with its registered address ("WS-87, FIRST FLOOR MAYAPURI PHASE II") returned no results (search backend unavailable: 'searx: Connection refused'), and volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403 on free view. Domestic supply therefore unverified, not disproven.
note: Trader/importer profile, not a manufacturer: the company appears in Indian customs data only as the BUYER of Chinese steel and aluminium doors from ZHEJIANG FUDAI INDUSTRIAL & TRADING CO., LTD (29 of the 43 records) and YONGKANG PHIPULO SMART HOME CO LIMITED. Declared HS 730830/730890 matches the observed import lines (73083000 steel doors; also 76109090 aluminium doors seen), so the HS claim is consistent with actual trade — but the direction is inbound, not outbound. No export shipments found and no traces of domestic supply found; the company's own site/catalogue claims were not treated as evidence. Revenue and export volume: null (not public). No CIN/PAN found in public sources. Note the same address block also appears linked to PELICANO INTERNATIONAL DECOR PRIVATE LIMITED and A P ENTERPRISES in the supplier-buyer pairings, which may indicate a shared trading address — worth clarifying with the supplier, but not a rejection ground.
